# terraform deploy pipeline
on:
    - push
    - pull_request

jobs:
    validation:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        steps:
            -   name:   Checkout Code
                uses:   actions/checkout@v4

            -   name:   Setup Terraform CLI
                uses:   hashicorp/setup-terraform@v4

            -   name:   Validate Terraform Code
                uses:   terraform validate
                
            -   name:   Run Tflint
                uses:   terraform tflint
            
            -   name:   Run Terraform Tests
                uses:   terraform tests

# provide an environment whether to push the code or not
